description: Implement the REAL iOS native focus path and prove it COMPILES: the Swift Expo native module + shared constants, the DeviceActivityMonitor (and optional ShieldConfiguration) extension sources, and the Expo config plugin that injects entitlements/app-group and the extension target via the withXcodeProject pbxproj escape hatch. Then run expo prebuild and the iPhone 16 simulator xcodebuild compile. This is the top compile-only risk (design.md section 7). Depends on FEAT-001 (app.config.ts, deps) and FEAT-002 (modules/goalie-focus/index.ts re-exports src/focus). Runtime blocking is UNVERIFIED here by hard constraint.
steps: Create /Users/Shared/goalie/modules/goalie-focus/ios/GoalieFocusConstants.swift: the single shared section 4.4 constants compiled into BOTH the main module and the extension target. App group 'group.com.goalie.app.focus'; selection key 'selection.v1'; session key 'session.v1'; ManagedSettingsStore name 'goalie.focus'; DeviceActivityName 'goalie.focus.session'.

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/modules/goalie-focus/ios/GoalieFocusModule.swift: an expo-modules-core Module exposing the section 4.1 async functions (getAuthorizationStatus, requestAuthorization using .individual, presentActivityPicker, getSelection, startFocusSession, stopFocusSession, getActiveSession) with the exact error codes (E_AUTH_DENIED, E_AUTH_FAILED, E_PICKER_CANCELLED, E_SESSION_ACTIVE, E_INVALID_DURATION, E_NO_SELECTION, E_NOT_AUTHORIZED, E_SCHEDULE_FAILED, E_SHIELD_FAILED). Enforce the section 4.3 ordering invariant: step 3.0 validate with no side effects + reject E_SESSION_ACTIVE if session.v1 exists + duration validation [60,86400] (section 4.5); step a schedule FIRST (defensive DeviceActivityCenter().stopMonitoring([activityName]) in do/catch, then startMonitoring; on throw reject E_SCHEDULE_FAILED applying NO shields); step b apply shield with the best-effort observable rollback (clear shield.applications/.applicationCategories to nil, stopMonitoring in do/catch capturing secondary error, skip persist, reject E_SHIELD_FAILED); step c persist session.v1 with id = UUID().uuidString and selectionSummary RECOMPUTED by decoding selection.v1 as '<n> apps, <m> categories'. stopFocusSession idempotent from constants (safe when nothing persisted). Serialize FamilyActivitySelection via JSONEncoder to app-group UserDefaults as Data; tokens never cross the JS bridge (only the count summary does).
Create /Users/Shared/goalie/modules/goalie-focus/expo-module.config.json declaring the iOS module (platforms ['ios'], ios.modules ['GoalieFocusModule']).
Create /Users/Shared/goalie/modules/goalie-focus/index.ts re-exporting the JS API from ../../src/focus (GoalieFocus + types + availability), so the module package surface matches the design layout.

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/ios-extensions/DeviceActivityMonitor/GoalieMonitor.swift: a DeviceActivityMonitor subclass overriding intervalDidEnd(for:) to clear the named ManagedSettingsStore('goalie.focus') shield (applications + applicationCategories) when the activity matches DeviceActivityName('goalie.focus.session'), referencing the shared constants. This is why the schedule must exist before the shield (section 4.3 step 5).
Optionally create /Users/Shared/goalie/ios-extensions/ShieldConfiguration/GoalieShieldConfig.swift for custom shield UI (ShieldConfigurationDataSource).

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/modules/goalie-focus/plugin/withGoalieFocus.ts using @expo/config-plugins@54.0.6 (transitive dep of expo@54.0.38; do NOT add it to package.json as a direct dep unless prebuild requires it). (1) withEntitlementsPlist adds com.apple.developer.family-controls=true and com.apple.security.application-groups=['group.com.goalie.app.focus'] to the main app. (2) withXcodeProject escape hatch driving the bundled xcode@^4.0.0 pbxproj library to perform the section 5.1 mutations for the DeviceActivityMonitor extension (bundle id com.goalie.app.DeviceActivityMonitor): create an app-extension PBXNativeTarget (productType com.apple.product-type.app-extension); add a PBXSourcesBuildPhase compiling GoalieMonitor.swift (templated from ios-extensions/DeviceActivityMonitor/) + the shared GoalieFocusConstants.swift, registering PBXBuildFile/PBXFileReference/PBXGroup; generate a dedicated extension entitlements file (Family Controls + App Groups) and point CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS at it; write the extension Info.plist with NSExtensionPointIdentifier=com.apple.deviceactivity.monitor-extension (+ NSExtensionPrincipalClass) and set INFOPLIST_FILE; set IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=16.0 and DEVELOPMENT_TEAM='<<APPLE_TEAM_ID>>' in Debug+Release via a new XCConfigurationList; add a PBXCopyFilesBuildPhase with dstSubfolderSpec=13 ('Embed App Extensions') to the main app target with the extension .appex, plus a PBXTargetDependency so the extension builds first.
Register the plugin in /Users/Shared/goalie/app.config.ts by replacing the FEAT-001 TODO with './modules/goalie-focus/plugin/withGoalieFocus' in the plugins array.

Run npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean and iterate on withGoalieFocus.ts against prebuild + the compile command until the project loads and builds; a malformed pbxproj mutation surfaces here as a prebuild or Xcode project-load/compile failure.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes for modules/goalie-focus/index.ts and plugin/withGoalieFocus.ts.

npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean generates ios/ containing the main-app Family Controls + App Groups entitlements and a DeviceActivityMonitor app-extension target embedded in the app with its own entitlements and Info.plist (NSExtensionPointIdentifier=com.apple.deviceactivity.monitor-extension).
The iPhone 16 simulator xcodebuild (CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO) reports BUILD SUCCEEDED, proving the Swift module + extension + plugin-generated targets compile against the iOS 18.5 SDK.
Tokens never cross the JS bridge; only the count-based summary does (verified by code review of GoalieFocusModule.swift).
verification: cd /Users/Shared/goalie && WS=$(ls -d ios/*.xcworkspace); SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WS" -json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const a=JSON.parse(s).workspace.schemes;console.log(a.find(x=>x==="Goalie")??a[0])})'); xcodebuild -workspace "$WS" -scheme "$SCHEME" -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
